headline: Dialog Semiconductor author reports production chip-level analog regressions
fact: A 2020 CadenceLIVE paper by Dialog Semiconductor's Yi Wang describes a programmable Verilog-AMS testbench with SystemVerilog Assertions and an asynchronous state machine for chip-level analog regressions. The paper reports more than 30 scenarios and 156 runs completing in 9.5 hours for daily signoff; Cadence's conference repository says the simulated results were subsequently supported by silicon measurements.

sources.title: CadenceLIVE Europe 2020 Proceedings
sources.summary: Cadence's conference repository lists Yi Wang of Dialog Semiconductor and summarizes the chip-level analog-regression work and silicon-measurement follow-up.

sources.title: Chip-Level Analog Regressions in Production
sources.summary: The Dialog paper documents the programmable testbench, assertions, scenario count, regression volume, and reported runtime.
